query_example: Is the non-compete clause enforceable in this jurisdiction?
resolution_template: Check jurisdiction + duration reasonableness + geographic scope + consideration

query_example: Are the liquidated damages provisions enforceable?
resolution_template: Determine if amount is genuine pre-estimate of loss vs penalty; check Cavendish Square test

query_example: Does the force majeure clause apply to this situation?
resolution_template: Identify triggering event, foreseeability, causation link, notice obligation

query_example: What notice is required to terminate this agreement?
resolution_template: Identify notice length, method of service, when notice starts running

query_example: Who owns the intellectual property created under this contract?
resolution_template: Check assignment clause scope, timing (pre/post contract), carve-outs for pre-existing IP

query_example: What does the indemnification clause cover?
resolution_template: Scope of indemnity (direct vs third-party), caps, exclusions (negligence, wilful misconduct)

query_example: What is the cap on liability under this contract?
resolution_template: Identify cap amount/formula, excluded loss types, carve-outs (fraud, death, IP)

query_example: Which law governs this agreement and where must disputes be resolved?
resolution_template: Note chosen law, exclusive vs non-exclusive jurisdiction, arbitration seat if applicable

query_example: How long does the confidentiality obligation last?
resolution_template: Duration post-termination, carve-outs (public domain, compelled disclosure), standard of care

query_example: When must payment be made and what are the consequences of late payment?
resolution_template: Payment trigger, due date, interest rate on late payment, set-off rights

query_example: Are warranties excluded or limited under this agreement?
resolution_template: Implied warranty exclusion validity by jurisdiction, express warranties, remedy on breach

query_example: What constitutes a material breach allowing termination?
resolution_template: Define material breach threshold, cure notice length, termination timing, survival clauses

query_example: What data protection obligations apply under this agreement?
resolution_template: Identify controller/processor roles, lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification

query_example: Can the contract be amended verbally or must changes be in writing?
resolution_template: Check no-oral-modification clause enforceability (Rock Advertising v MWB), formality requirements

query_example: Can either party assign their rights or obligations?
resolution_template: Assignment of rights vs obligations, consent requirement, change of control trigger

query_example: Is this claim time-barred under the applicable limitation period?
resolution_template: Identify cause of action, accrual date, applicable limitation period, any contractual shortening

query_example: Was the employee wrongfully dismissed?
resolution_template: Check contractual notice given vs owed, grounds for summary dismissal, statutory minimums

query_example: Is this clause unfair or unenforceable under consumer protection law?
resolution_template: Identify B2C vs B2B, apply UCTA reasonableness or CRA fairness test, core terms exemption

query_example: What regulatory compliance obligations does this contract impose?
resolution_template: Identify sector regulations, compliance party, change in law provisions, cost allocation

query_example: What steps must be taken before commencing litigation or arbitration?
resolution_template: Map pre-litigation steps (negotiation → mediation → arbitration/court), time limits at each stage

query_example: What is the permitted scope of use under this software licence?
resolution_template: Identify licence type (perpetual/subscription), scope (users/modules/geography), audit rights

query_example: How is the earn-out payment calculated and when is it due?
resolution_template: Identify metric, measurement period, cap/floor, accounting standards, dispute mechanism
